svg.text: OPCODE_ROM drives the grey region (CS_n..CA5 fixed H/L per cmd; CA1 = 1cyc/2cyc). FIELD_MUX drives the rest (BA/BG/CID/row/col/ap...) picked by cmd+ui. * = BL bit.

text.font-family: Inter, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Encoder per phase = OPCODE_ROM (cmd->CA[5:0]) + FIELD_MUX array (each higher CA pin picks a field bit by cmd_type & ui_idx) + CS_GEN (cs_n=L one-cold on UI0, else H) -> ASSEMBLE -> dfi_address_p0[13:0] + dfi_cs_p0. Bit positions from Table 241. Pure comb; x GEAR.
